title: Google parent Alphabet hits $4tn valuation after AI deal with Apple
summary: After Apple chose Gemini to power Siri, Alphabet surpassed Apple to become second-most valuable company in world Google ’s parent company hit a major financial milestone on Monday, reaching a $4tn valuation for the first time and surpassing Apple to become the second-most valuable company in the world. Alphabet is the fourth company to hit the $4tn milestone after Nvidia , which later hit $5tn , Microsoft and Apple . Continue reading...

title: GoFundMe Ignores Own Rules by Hosting a Legal-Defense Fund for the ICE Agent Who Killed Renee Good
summary: The fundraiser for the ICE agent in the Renee Good killing has stayed online in seeming breach of GoFundMe’s own terms of service, prompting questions about selective enforcement.
